note: « Laya hors ligne »: the one model pack BMM installs. Pinned here, in src-tauri/src/commands/ai_embedded.rs and in BetterInstaller/examples/bmm/installer.toml; the tests fail when they drift. Built by scripts/laya/build_pack.py; measured by scripts/laya/measure.py.

measured.note: scripts/laya/measure.py on 59 texts (EN/FR/DE/ES/IT/PT/RU/PL/JA/ZH), 186 answers (84 choice, 102 yes/no), vs the fp32 PyTorch Agent. CPU, 2 threads, one text per call. Sept 2026.

chosen.flips: 2, both near-ties in the reference (margins 0.020 and 0.061)

pipeline.note: « Laya v2 » (src-tauri/src/commands/ai_laya.rs): what BMM asks and how the answers are combined. Measured by measure_pipeline (src-tauri/src/commands/ai_eval.rs) on src-tauri/tests/laya_eval.json (scripts/laya/eval_set.py): 156 tuning items (weights fitted on the even ids) + 68 BLIND items written after the freeze and never tuned on. Int8 pack, CPU, 2 threads, Sept 2026.

tuning_before_after.language_mods: 26.6 % -> 90.6 % right (precision 98.3 %, coverage 92.2 %): the stop-word/letter detector; Laya is not asked (37 % right on prose)
tuning_before_after.report_severity: 29.2 % -> 60.4 % (category prior + escalation words, Laya as tie-breaker)

blind_before_after.tags_f1: 0.161 -> 0.364 (P 0.385 -> 0.500); 30 of the 36 mods use tags BMM has no concept for (eras, Multiplayer, Cosmetic): 0.154 -> 0.338 on those, 0.200 -> 0.500 on known tags

pipeline.latency: per item, int8 pack, 2 threads: median 732 ms, p90 1033 ms (tuning) / median 725 ms (blind); was median 470 ms, p90 2755 ms: fewer, better-targeted questions per mod (at most 10 candidates + 1 choice + adult content, against 16 yes/no + 2 before)
pipeline.honesty: The keyword evidence lists in ai_laya.rs were written knowing the tuning items: the tuning figures are optimistic; the blind figures are the ones to quote.

router.note: Should BMM ship a second pack? The same questions re-asked (scripts/laya/compare_packs.py) with fp32 PyTorch checkpoints and scored by the bench's own rules (BMM_LAYA_EVAL_REPLAY), on the ENGLISH items only (28 mods, 20 reports, 12 dups tuning; 22 mods, 10 reports, 6 dups blind).

checkpoints.convaiinnovations/laya-typed-decisions: not measured: trained for invoices, security incidents, customer service and agent traces (its model card); nothing BMM asks

english_items_v2.multilingual_int8_shipped: tuning tags F1 0.850, category 65 %, severity 65 %, dups 10/12 | blind tags F1 0.408, category 60 %, severity 50 %, dups 4/6
english_items_v2.multilingual_fp32: tuning tags F1 0.850, category 60 %, severity 60 %, dups 9/12 | blind tags F1 0.400, category 60 %, severity 50 %, dups 4/6
english_items_v2.english_fp32: tuning tags F1 0.875, category 65 %, severity 60 %, dups 11/12 | blind tags F1 0.431, category 70 %, severity 80 %, dups 3/6
english_items_v2.ensemble_mean(english_fp32, multilingual: tuning tags F1 0.872, category 65 %, severity 60 %, dups 10/12 | blind tags F1 0.511 (P 0.750), category 70 %, severity 70 %, dups 3/6
english_items_v2.latency: english fp32 took 1.9x the time of multilingual fp32 on the same calls (569 s vs 294 s, 10 threads)

router.decision: ONE pack shipped. The English checkpoint helps a little on English text (blind tag F1 +0.10 in an ensemble, on 22 mods) and nothing on the nine other languages, for a second ~450 MB download, ~2x the latency and the RAM of two models. The router (ai_laya::route, ai_embedded::packs) is in place: adding it = export + quantize with scripts/laya/build_pack.py, publish the zip as a release asset, pin it here and in ai_embedded.rs.
